data.name: Junaid
data.gender_notes: Junaid is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Diminutive of jund, 'army', from the Arabic root ج-ن-د (j-n-d). Its root is ج-ن-د (j-n-d). A common Muslim given name. Junaid is a Arabic name meaning “Small army; soldier; warrior”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Junaid expresses “Small army; soldier; warrior”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: Diminutive of jund, 'army', from the Arabic root ج-ن-د (j-n-d).
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Junaid total 23, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
